D/ IMP CARAVSIVS P F AVG ; R/ RENOVAT ROMANO

Silver denarius of Carausius (AD 286-293) (Reece period 14), RENOVAT (ROMA)NO, Wolf and twins. Mint of London, RSR. RIC V, pt 2, no. 571. Obverse description: Laureate, draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: IMP CARAVSIVS P F AVG. Reverse description: Wolf right suckling twins. Reverse inscription: RENOVAT ROMANO. In exergue: RSR. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin citing Sear volume 4 no. 13527. Diameter: 19.9mm, Weight: 4.46gms, die axis: 6. Denarii of Carausius are rare, but the Wolf and Twins types are the most common issue
